# AI-03: Model APIs and Local Inference (Tier 3)

**Subtrack:** AI Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Provider APIs, streaming, retries and rate limits, provider abstraction and running open-weight models locally.

**Tier note:** Tier 3 has one assessment, on an inference-serving trade-off study (quantisation, batching, latency against quality). Broader serving architecture is assessed in AI-13 and ML-12.

- **[AI-T3-002](AI-T3-002-thirty-students-one-lab-pc/README.md): Thirty Students, One Lab PC: A Quantisation and Batching Study for Local Inference.** Implement low-bit quantisation and a static/continuous batching simulator for a toy language model with planted outlier channels and an analytic CPU cost model, then recommend, defend and stress-test a quantisation and batching configuration for a 30-student campus lab under a p95 latency SLO.
